Reporting viewLatest available
How the headline measures are calculated

ED presentations and hospital admissions are summed across the selected districts. Waiting time, asthma rate and smoking prevalence are unweighted averages across available Local Health District records. When “All” years is selected, each measure uses its own latest available reporting year.

Geographic view

NSW Local Health Districts

Each district is coloured by the selected indicator for the displayed year. Darker teal represents a higher recorded value. Hover for the exact value, or click a district to apply it as the dashboard filter.

Performance heatmap

All available years

Rows are districts and columns are reporting years. Darker cells mean higher values within the selected indicator’s full observed range; pale cells with a dash have no record.

Historical trends

Follow the signal over time

Trend over time

Year-on-year change

Shows relative change from the immediately preceding reporting year. Teal bars above zero are increases; coral bars below zero are decreases. This is percentage change, not percentage-point change.

Health relationships

Explore possible associations

Matching district and reporting-year records are compared. Correlation does not imply causation.

Smoking vs asthma

Each dot is one district-year match. Moving right indicates higher smoking prevalence; moving up indicates a higher age-standardised asthma hospitalisation rate.

ED volume vs waiting time

Each dot is one district-year match. The chart explores whether districts with more ED presentations also report longer median waiting times.

ED presentations vs admissions

ED presentationsHospital admissions

Paired bars compare the two reported counts within each district. The datasets may cover different patient populations and episodes, so this is not a patient-conversion measure.
